prompt:
Create ONE image, landscape 3:2. It is a HEADS SHEET for paper cut-out puppet animation: eight different HEADS, each in strict side profile facing RIGHT, each with a short neck at the bottom, same scale. eight generic Roman politicians of the late Republic, 1st century BC, all clearly different: (1) a lean man with a laurel wreath and receding short hair, (2) a broad-faced man with thick short hair, (3) an older heavy-set man with a double chin, (4) a very young clean-shaven man with neat short hair, (5) a strong man with curly hair and a short beard, (6) a thin older man with grey hair, (7) a stern bald man, (8) a middle-aged man with a long nose; a teal toga collar where the neck shows. Vary age, face shape, facial hair and expression; keep the same art style. Background: perfectly flat solid magenta #FF00FF everywhere, no shadows, no gradients, no texture on the background. Layout: an invisible 4 columns x 2 rows grid of equal cells; put exactly ONE item centred in each cell, fully inside its cell with wide magenta margins, items never touching. No grid lines, no labels, no text.

Art style for every asset in this library: flat hand-painted paper cut-out illustration for a history explainer animation, clean simple shapes, subtle paper grain, thin dark-brown outline, soft muted natural colours, gentle painterly shading, consistent proportions (adult figure about 7 heads tall).
Costumes are SYMBOLIC and GENERIC for the era and region: suggest the period through silhouette, headwear, garment cut and weapon type only. Do not copy any specific dynasty, uniform, museum piece or real insignia. No writing, no letters, no numbers, no real flags, no religious symbols, no real coats of arms. Emblems, if any, are simple invented geometric shapes.
Faction colour rule: every cloth part that shows which side a character fights for (main tunic or robe panel, headband, sash, cape, shield paint, banner) is painted in solid TEAL #2A8C8C. Nothing else in the image uses teal or any blue-green: skin, hair, wood, leather, metal, straw stay natural colours.
